title: The town of Barcelona
text: It has been a rich and entertaining tour, very well focused on the life of the people of Barcelona, its circumstances and avatars. I loved it, the guide was didactic and I think it has articulated a historical and current content with grace and sensitivity. Highly recommended🤗
